name: @futuretea/rancher-mcp-server

tools.name: kubernetes_diff
tools.description: Compare two Kubernetes resource versions and show the differences as a git-style diff. Useful for comparing current vs desired state, or before/after changes.

ignoreMeta.description: Ignore non-essential metadata differences (managedFields, resourceVersion, etc.)

ignoreStatus.description: Ignore changes under the status field when computing diffs

resource1.description: First resource version as JSON string (the 'before' or 'old' version). Use kubernetes_get to retrieve the resource.

resource2.description: Second resource version as JSON string (the 'after' or 'new' version). Use kubernetes_get to retrieve the resource.
